title: Podman desktop cannot find podman machine
body:
### Bug description

Podman desktop cannot see my podman machine. I only have a single podman machine. All my cli podman commands work fine.

I am on podman 5.4.0 and podman desktop 1.16.1 (dropdown does not list 1.16.1 as an option)

I tried uninstalling and re-installing podman desktop.

I tried removing and recreating my podman machine both through the CLI and through podman-desktop.

Not sure what diagnostic information would be helpful here, but happy to provide whatever information would be helpful!

### Operating system

macOS Sequoid 15.1.1 (intel)

### Installation Method

Brew (macOS)

### Version

1.16.0

### Steps to reproduce

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
The reset didn't do anything. Glad you are able to reproduce on an intel mac and investigate as well!

Some more investigation points on my end:

My original post mentions my install was via brew. I wanted to take that complication out of the mix. When I was doing my testing above with podman versions, I was using installations from packages, not brew and the issue still persisted.

Also, after I compared the output of the `podman machine list --format=json` command, I realized that while I compared the contents, I didn't compare the capture mechanism. So I went back and double checked, both podman versions are outputting the data to `stdout` (would have been weird if it changed to stderr or something else in the new version... but at least would have been an explanation 🤣).

So I have no answers, just more things that are ruled out.

Good luck with your investigation, let me know if I can do anything else to help!
